text:
You need to go there in person. I accompanied a friend there last week in the same situation 
 She waited at the "chalon" (window ) and the lady gave her an appointment for mid May. My friend told her that she had tried sending emails and got no replies and they didn't answer so   the best way was to go there. If you have already uploaded all the required documents on their website as should be done before an A5 appointment,  mention it .
